title: Core: AS2 exception handling (throw, try-catch-finally)
description: Test compilation of: try { ... } catch(e:Error) { trace(e.message); } finally { ... }. Test: throw new Error('msg'), throw 'string', throw 42. Test ActionTry (0x8F) and ActionThrow (0x2A) opcodes. Test nested try-catch. Test re-throw: catch(e) { throw e; }. Test Error subclasses: class MyError extends Error {}; throw new MyError().
